title: Cortex: Achieving Low-Latency, Cost-Efficient Remote Data Access For LLM via Semantic-Aware Knowledge Caching
selection_reason: Asteria/Cortex is a cross-region semantic caching architecture for LLM agent tool access, with semantic elements and a retrieval index carrying latency and cost metadata; a caching system reducing LLM workflow latency and cost.
